name: Accessory Mitral Valve Tissue

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Accessory Mitral Valve Tissue Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Visualization of accessory mitral valve tissue on echocardiography
Presence of left ventricular outflow tract obstruction caused by accessory tissue
Symptoms consistent with mitral valve dysfunction or obstruction

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Echocardiographic visualization of accessory mitral valve tissue with or without left ventricular outflow tract obstruction
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis primarily relies on imaging; clinical symptoms support but are not mandatory.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Accessory mitral valve tissue visualized on echocardiography
searchTerms: extra tissue on mitral valve seen on echo
obstruction in left heart valve area

common.symptomName: Systolic murmur due to turbulent flow
searchTerms: heart murmur from turbulent blood flow
systolic murmur due to abnormal flow

common.symptomName: Fatigue related to decreased cardiac output
searchTerms: fatigue due to low cardiac output

rare.symptomName: Embolic events secondary to accessory tissue
rare.notes: Rarely, accessory tissue may cause embolism

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; possible elevated BNP in heart failure
imaging: Echocardiography showing accessory mitral valve tissue
Doppler demonstrating left ventricular outflow tract obstruction
Cardiac MRI for detailed anatomical assessment
genetic: No specific genetic markers identified; sporadic cases
other: Electrocardiogram may show arrhythmias or left ventricular hypertrophy

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of accessory tissue on echocardiography
Typical leaflet billowing rather than accessory tissue
Fixed subaortic membrane causing obstruction rather than mobile accessory tissue
Asymmetric septal hypertrophy without accessory mitral valve tissue
Dynamic obstruction related to septal hypertrophy

redFlags: Severe left ventricular outflow tract obstruction causing syncope
Signs of heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
Evidence of embolic stroke or systemic embolism
references: Maron BJ, et al. Accessory mitral valve tissue: clinical and echocardiographic features. J Am Coll Cardiol. 1986.
Mookadam F, et al. Accessory mitral valve tissue: a comprehensive review. Echocardiography. 2010.
